sloka: यज्ञवाटगताश्चापि मुनयः सर्व एव ते ।राजानश्च नरव्याघ्रा विस्मयान्नोपरेमिरे ।। ७.९७.२४ ॥
transliteration: yajñavāṭagatāścāpi munayaḥ sarva eva te ।rājānaśca naravyāghrā vismayānnoparemire ।। 7.97.24 ॥

translations.english: All those sages and kings, who were like tigers among men, present in the sacrificial enclosure, did not cease their astonishment.
